violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Child 12 years old or younger must not ride in the front seat of a vehicle (26 TAC §747.5407(d))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Child 12 years old or younger must not ride in the front seat of a vehicle
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation it was determined that a child under 12 was allowed to sit in the front passenger seat during transportation.

finding_variants.text: During the investigation it was determined that a child under 12 was allowed to sit in the front passenger seat during transportation.

A 10-year-old child had sat in the front seat of the vehicle while being transported from school to daycare by the operation.       NOTE: During today's inspection, children did not seat in the front seat.
